title: Export from each tab holds only that tab's parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · a program that opens the exported file (e.g. a spreadsheet program) · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], signed in with the Admin role. Admin holds the 'Part Library & Inventory' permissions View, Create & Edit and Delete by default (Settings → Roles & Permissions); Delete is what allows Deactivate parts and Activate parts.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: at [Loc-1], active [Part-A] and [Part-B] and inactive [Part-C], part numbers starting ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP- (examples).

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. Create [Part-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL export A" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP-01 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-A] = the part number you typed.
  3. Create [Part-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL export B" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP-02 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-B] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [Part-C]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL export C" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP-03 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-C] = the part number you typed.
  5. Make [Part-C] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-C] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  6. Check the setup worked: the Active tab searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP lists [Part-A] and [Part-B]; the Inactive tab lists [Part-C].
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu (Active tab).
  2. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar.
  4. Click Export.
  5. Open the downloaded file and look for [Part-A], [Part-B] and [Part-C].
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
  7. If the Search box is empty, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP in it.
  8. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  9. Click Export.
  10. Open the second downloaded file and look for [Part-A], [Part-B] and [Part-C].
  11. Pick up to 3 other part numbers from the second file and search each on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: A file downloads.
  • Step 5: The file from the Active tab holds [Part-A] and [Part-B] and does not hold [Part-C].
  • Step 9: A second file downloads.
  • Step 10: The file from the Inactive tab holds [Part-C] and does not hold [Part-A] or [Part-B].
  • Step 11: Every part number picked from the second file is found on the Inactive tab: the Inactive export holds only inactive parts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S1-R9, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.1 (The actions menu).
